long_description:
On Saturday, November 14, we’re taking over The Foundry SF for our final rave of the year, and this one will be our biggest primetime production yet!

It’s Diwali season, and also DSR’s one-year anniversary, so we’re putting together a proper carnival of lights and sounds to celebrate!

✨ What to Expect

⚡🎉The Space & Vibe:

We're trading the daytime sunshine for lasers and concrete at The Foundry SF in the heart of SoMa. This historic industrial warehouse comes equipped with an incredible heavy-hitting sound system, and is the perfect canvas for our signature Dil Se festival production, dialed up for the dark.

🎵🔥 The Sound:

Your favorite Bollywood and pop anthems, heavily reworked with deep house, tech house, and underground EDM energy. Check out your DJs on Instagram-\

\

\

👕 The Look:

Underground Rave meets South Asian heritage!\

Bring out the neon, the glow, and the dark festival drip. Whether you're blending ethnic jewelry with your best rave fit, or going full Diwali with festive wear, wear whatever makes you feel unstoppable under the lasers.

💫 If you've joined us in the past, you know the energy. If you missed it, now is your chance to see why this community is growing so fast.

✌️ We promise you'll leave with a lighter heart, tired legs, and a few new friends.

💖To our DSR fam:

Last November, 150 people of you put your trust in us at the first-ever public Dil Se Rave. Since then, this community has helped us bring DSR to some of San Francisco’s most iconic venues and even enabled us to take the experience to the East Coast.

To everyone in San Francisco who has shown up, brought friends, danced with us, and helped this community grow: thank you! This anniversary is yours, too.

Come celebrate how far we’ve come, experience our biggest production yet, and close out the year with one last DSR night!

🎟️ Event Details:

**Venue:** The Foundry SF\

**📍 Location:** 1425 Folsom St, San Francisco, CA 94103\

**📅 Date:** Saturday, November 14\
